title: synthyris plantaginea
intro: Synthyris plantaginea, commonly known as the boggerlily, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Synthyris plantaginea include acting as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and exhibiting antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
